title: Public Contact Research
description: Provide people you already know and their company domains. The Actor only reads public company pages; it does not search private contact databases or infer email addresses.

contacts.title: Known contacts and company domains
contacts.description: 1–25 caller-supplied contacts. companyDomain is required. fullName helps locate a public mention on the company site, but is optional.

fullName.title: Full name
fullName.description: Known business contact name used only to identify public mentions on the supplied company website.

companyDomain.title: Company domain
companyDomain.description: Public company website hostname, such as example.com. Do not provide private, local, or IP-address hosts.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Optional label returned unchanged in the result.

externalId.title: Your record ID
externalId.description: Optional identifier returned unchanged so results can be matched to your workflow.

maxContacts.title: Maximum contacts to process
maxContacts.description: Safety cap applied after validation. Use a lower number for a small canary run.

maxPagesPerContact.title: Maximum public pages per contact
maxPagesPerContact.description: The Actor tries the homepage, /contact, /about, and /team in a fixed bounded order.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Per-page request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Time limit for each public-page request.

useApifyUnblockerFallback.title: Use Apify Unblocker after a classified direct failure
useApifyUnblockerFallback.description: When enabled, a single Apify Unblocker retry is attempted only after a direct fetch is blocked or transiently unavailable. This can add Apify proxy usage charges.

preferApifyUnblocker.title: Prefer Apify Unblocker before a direct request
preferApifyUnblocker.description: Off by default. Enable only if a customer-authorized site consistently blocks direct public requests.
